title: Meet Rite
summary: Two phones, two yeses, one edge: one visitor opens a meeting, the other accepts it with their own mark, the opener confirms, and the guide appends one edge naming both.

opener.description: The visitor who opens the meeting and shows its code; the same mark confirms.

acceptor.description: The visitor shown the code, who says yes with their own mark.

guide.description: The chain-keeping guide (the Hitchhiker's Guide) that holds the meeting and appends the edge.

open.description: Open a meeting; the guide answers a five-character code valid for ten minutes.

accept.description: Say yes to the code with a different mark; the guide names the opener back.

confirm.description: The opener confirms after the acceptor's yes; the guide appends one meet edge naming both marks. Its success response exists only when the edge was appended (a refusal is a trust-task-error, a different document type), so reading this step by presence is sound here, unlike a step whose success response can carry a refusal (spec#52).

exposure.rationale: max() over the steps is metadata: each discloses a code, a mark or a link. Nothing personal travels; the edge names two pairwise marks on a public chain.

sideEffects.rationale: open and accept change a ten-minute meeting record; confirm appends one edge to an append-only chain. No step is destructive.
